description: This file defines the PackageNamePicker class, which extends PickerActivity. It constructs a command to retrieve package names from the Android system using dumpsys and sed, processes the output to produce a list of package names, and handles timeout and error conditions.

classes.name: PackageNamePicker
classes.description: A subclass of PickerActivity that retrieves a list of package names installed on the device, executing a system command and processing its output.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Overrides the method to run a shell command to fetch the package names, handle timeout, and display errors.
